comments.zh: <summary>场景 607 入口（ScenarioRegistry 注册）。</summary>
comments.en: <summary>Entry point for Scenario 607 (registered in ScenarioRegistry).</summary>

comments.zh: 全局 TraceEnabled 开关全流程：开启 → LogCallback 收集 → 映射 → 断言 → 关闭恢复。
comments.en: Global TraceEnabled toggle workflow: enable → LogCallback collection → mapping → assertion → disable and restore.

comments.zh: Enable: global switch + callback channel (Trace content is written to both GlobalOutput and the callback)
comments.en: Enable: global toggle + callback channel (Trace content is written simultaneously to GlobalOutput and the callback).

comments.zh: Restore off: Trace is a global diagnostic surface; it must be turned off after use to avoid polluting other scenarios
comments.en: Disable and restore: Trace is a global diagnostic surface; it must be disabled after use to avoid polluting other scenarios.

comments.zh: Assert: mapping-pair markers captured (type names appear in Trace output); failure means Error Summary -> exit code 1
comments.en: Assertion: capture mapping markers (type names appearing in Trace output); failure triggers an Error Summary → exit code 1.

comments.zh: 按调用追踪报告：MapTraceOptions.Enable(writer) 捕获到内存后做包含检查——
comments.en: Call-trace-based reporting: MapTraceOptions.Enable(writer) captures trace data in memory and performs inclusion checks.

comments.zh: 报告应覆盖四类映射方式标记（direct / nested / convert / skipped (MapIgnore)）。
comments.en: The report must cover markers for all four mapping methods: direct, nested, convert, and skipped (MapIgnore).

comments.zh: Trace is a forced-analysis mode (ignores the switch; the report is delivered via the return value -- not written to options.Output)
comments.en: Trace operates in forced analysis mode (ignores toggles; reports are delivered via return value—not written to options.Output).

comments.zh: Assert: all four mapping-kind markers appear (direct/nested/convert/skipped); a miss means non-zero exit code
comments.en: Assertion: all four mapping method markers (direct, nested, convert, skipped) must appear; missing any results in a non-zero exit code.
